kb.title: HS-400 solar panel
kb.text: The HS-400 is Helio Solar's standard monocrystalline panel. It is rated at 400 watts. The HS-400 has a 25-year product warranty. The HS-400 costs $420 per panel.

kb.title: HS-520 bifacial panel
kb.text: The HS-520 is a bifacial panel rated at 520 watts. The HS-520 has a 30-year product warranty. The HS-520 costs $610 per panel.

kb.title: Volta-2 inverter
kb.text: The Volta-2 is a 7.6 kW hybrid inverter. The Volta-2 inverter has a 10-year warranty. The Volta-2 supports one Lumen battery.

kb.title: Volta-X inverter
kb.text: The Volta-X is an 11.4 kW three-phase inverter. The Volta-X inverter has a 10-year warranty. The Volta-X supports up to three Lumen batteries.

kb.title: Lumen LB-13 battery
kb.text: The Lumen LB-13 is a 13.5 kWh home battery. The Lumen LB-13 has a 10-year warranty. The Lumen LB-13 costs $8,900.

kb.title: Installation fee policy
kb.text: The Helio installation fee is $180 per job plus $35 for each panel installed.

kb.title: Rush shipping policy
kb.text: Rush shipping adds a surcharge of 7% of the order value.

kb.title: Returns policy
kb.text: Unused equipment can be returned within 45 days. Every return needs an RMA number, which starts with HLX-.

kb.title: Support hours
kb.text: The Helio support desk is open from 07:00 to 19:00, Monday to Saturday.

kb.title: Service area
kb.text: Helio Solar installs in Nairobi, Mombasa and Kisumu.

kb.title: Volta-2 error E21
kb.text: Error E21 on a Volta-2 means the grid voltage is out of range: check the AC isolator.

kb.title: Volta-2 error E34
kb.text: Error E34 on a Volta-2 means battery communication was lost: reseat the CAN cable.

kb.title: Monitoring app
kb.text: Customers monitor their system in the Helio Pulse app.

kb.title: Escalation
kb.text: Technical cases the first line cannot solve go to the tier-2 desk at extension 4410.

e57.title: Volta-X error E57
e57.text: Error E57 on a Volta-X means a fan fault: clear the intake grille and restart the inverter.

clean.title: Panel cleaning
clean.text: Helio recommends cleaning the panels every 6 months.

mesh.title: Bird mesh kit
mesh.text: The Helio bird mesh kit costs $95.

maxpanels.title: Volta-2 panel limit
maxpanels.text: A Volta-2 inverter takes at most 18 panels.

firmware.title: Volta-2 firmware
firmware.text: The latest Volta-2 firmware is version 4.2.1.

cable.title: Battery cable
cable.text: The Lumen LB-13 connects with the Helio CB-3 cable.

updates.title: Volta-2 inverter
updates.text: The Volta-2 is a 7.6 kW hybrid inverter. From November 2026 the Volta-2 inverter has a 12-year warranty. The Volta-2 supports one Lumen battery.

updates.title: Service area
updates.text: Helio Solar installs in Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu and Nakuru.

updates.title: Installation fee policy
updates.text: The Helio installation fee is $200 per job plus $35 for each panel installed.
